diskChartHint: Click a slice or check a directory to select items for cleanup.
stale: This feature has newer data. Check again before acting.
diskScope: Common locations only. Large items are not necessarily safe to remove; moving to trash may not immediately free space.
processScope: Top 10 processes by usage. Identity is checked again before execution.
processActionNotice: A close request does not guarantee exit. Check the actual outcome.
localAction: Direct user action · No model request
formPrivacy: Use the same controls as the application. Local inputs and results are not automatically sent to the model.
mainWindowForm: This operation uses the main window for file selection and system controls.
analysisOnly: Analysis only; nothing has been deleted.
quickConfirmRisk: The selected categories will be permanently deleted. Items in Trash cannot be restored after this cleanup. Close apps that may be using these files.
outputTruncated: This is an excerpt. Open the operation to inspect the complete current result.

history.failure: TCP probe failure rate (not packet loss)
history.noResources: No resource samples cover this range. Recording may be off, cleared, or expired.
history.samplesOnly: Only saved samples are summarized; gaps are not reconstructed.
history.noNetwork: No saved network history covers this range. No new checks were started.
history.noAlerts: No saved resource alerts cover this range. Missing incidents cannot be reconstructed.
history.unmatched: The selected incident does not match a saved alert. Only available observations are shown.
history.exact: Includes the selected alert and saved records from the same occurrence; other alerts are excluded.
